name.value: Bajaj Life Linked Accident Protection Rider II

linked_or_non_linked.value: linked-base, non-participating, individual pure risk rider offering health cover and savings; separate rider premium
linked_or_non_linked.quote: A Non-Participating, Linked, Individual Pure Risk offering Health Cover and Savings Rider

waiver_of_premium.note: The rider covers accidental death and accidental total permanent disability, each with or without return of premium.

waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.note: The rider covers accidental death and accidental total permanent disability, each with or without return of premium.

waiver_on_death_or_illness_of_proposer.note: The rider covers accidental death and accidental total permanent disability, each with or without return of premium.

critical_illness.note: The rider covers accidental death and accidental total permanent disability, each with or without return of premium.

accidental_death.value: Higher of the ADB sum assured or 105% of total premiums paid, as a lump sum, on death by accident (also if death follows within 180 days after the term ends). ADB cover up to 3 times the base policy sum assured. With ROP option, the premiums paid come back on survival to maturity.
accidental_death.quote: higher of ADB Sum Assured or Guaranteed Benefit (i.e. 105% of Total Premiums Paid*) will be paid as a lumpsum

accidental_disability.value: Accidental total permanent disability benefit, with or without return of premium; ATPD sum assured at most the base policy sum assured.

term_cover.note: The rider covers accidental death and accidental total permanent disability, each with or without return of premium.

hospital_cash.note: The rider covers accidental death and accidental total permanent disability, each with or without return of premium.

other.value: Return of premium options on ADB and ATPD: total premiums paid on survival till maturity.
other.quote: Return of Premium Option: Get back your Total Premiums Paid

rider_term.value: ADB and ATPD: 1 to 67 years. ADB with ROP and ATPD with ROP: 10 to 50 years. Aligned to the base policy term.

premium_paying_rules.value: Single (1 year), limited (PPT 2 to 66, PT at least PPT + 1) or regular pay (PPT = PT, 2 to 67). For ROP options PPT 5 to 50 and PT at least PPT + 5. Frequency as base policy.

entry_age.value: Up to 65 years (attained age); minimum maturity age 19 (28 with ROP), maximum 85

sum_assured_limits.value: Minimum Rs 1,00,000 per cover option. Maximum subject to underwriting: ADB up to 3 times the base sum assured, ATPD up to the base sum assured.

premium_deduction.value: Collected over and above the base policy premium, as a separate rider premium. Not deducted from the fund.
premium_deduction.quote: Rider Premium would be collected over and above the base policy premium
